name: std::char_traits<char>::eof, std::char_traits<wchar_t>::eof, std::char_traits<char8_t>::eof, std::char_traits<char16_t>::eof, std::char_traits<char32_t>::eof
intro:
Returns a value not equivalent to any valid value of type char_type.

See CharTraits for the general requirements on character traits for X::eof.
